label: Q1 mae stability (confirmatory)

perturbations.description: seed block: run the frozen q1_fix.py on repeat 0 and repeat 1 as two separate post-plan experiments (frozen SEEDS 20261025 / 20261026); compare A/F30 pooled mae
lambda grid perturbation: LAMBDAS (0.1,1.0,10.0) -> (0.05,0.5,5.0) at the inner selection step, same outer folds / representations / ranks / gamma grids; other protocol steps unchanged

decisionRule.reference: first linked experiment = the post-plan reference

dataUse.note: train-only 3x3x3 nested CV; no holdout is consumed; the immutable NESTED-CV-1 assignment is reused; split-integrity/holdout-metrics structural gaps do not disappear because of robustness

limitations: split-integrity and holdout-metrics stay structurally unsatisfiable (no holdout, EXP-0073 has no splitId); robustness does not remove them
multiple-seeds = frozen repeat blocks 0/1 only (2 of the 3 frozen seeds were executed); the third seed was not run
